inputs.note: 1-D signal with 3 local maxima at indices 2 (value 3), 7 (value 5), and 11 (value 4, a width-2 plateau at indices 11-12 -- find_peaks's midpoint = (left_edge+right_edge)//2 picks the LEFT of the plateau pair). First/last samples can never be peaks by construction (i starts at 1, loop bound is x.shape[0]-1).
